title: introduce-cost-nudger-policy-generator-and-tenant-scorer
author: Nina Patel
release_notes: Adds Cost Nudger: an automated suggestion engine that synthesizes tenant-level batching/caching/quantization recommendations and provides a dry-run CLI + safe-apply canary. No breaking API changes.
description:
Problem/context: Large tenants routinely miss simple opportunity windows to reduce unit cost (batching, prefix cache config, or switching to compact quant profiles) because manual tuning is slow and risky. This PR adds an automated 'Cost Nudger' generator that synthesizes tenant-scored recommendations, simulates expected unit-econ impact via offline replay, and exposes a dry-run CLI and safe-apply path that performs canary rollouts plus telemetry.

What this changes (high level):
- Introduces a tenant scorer that ranks candidates for batch/cache/quant nudges using usage signals and latency SLOs.
- Adds an offline simulator to estimate per-token delta cost and latency impact (uses replay traces + lightweight emulation of batching/warmup).
- Adds a policy-generator that emits JSON policy proposals (batch size targets, cache TTL presets, quant profile suggestions) with confidence scores and rollback guards.
- Adds a cost-nudger CLI: `redwood cost-nudge plan --tenant X --dry-run` + `apply --canary` flows.
- Wire up events to telemetry (new metrics prefixed with nudger.*) and store proposals in /admin/tenant-proposals for audit.

Review conversation (selected highlights):

- Priya Shah (review): "Simulator is heavy — can we provide a fast-path that uses summary histograms for very large tenants?" 
  - Nina (reply): "Added histogram mode in simulator with --histogram flag; defaults to full replay only for high-confidence recommendations. Documented tradeoffs in the runbook."
- Leo Grant (approval): "Approach and safety gates look solid. Verified canary rollback triggers on latency regression in smoke runs. Approve."

Operational / Security notes:
- Proposals include a 'max-risk' field. The policy generator will not recommend quant profile changes that increase CPU per-token > 5% without explicit opt-in label on the tenant.
- Audit trail stored in the existing admin datastore and encrypted at rest; proposals have creator metadata and a hash to detect tampering.
- This PR intentionally does not auto-apply any recommendation without an explicit `apply --canary` invocation by an operator or a scheduled job gated by an allowlist.

Backwards compatibility: no public API surfaces are changed. CLI additions are additive. No breaking migration.
